subject: TaskForce is moving to your desktop
preheader: Free, open source, on Windows. Your work comes along in one click.
pill: TaskForce Desktop, free and open source
h1: TaskForce is moving to your desktop.
lead: Your projects, issues and Brain OS in one app, on your own computer. And Claude Code when an issue needs a hand.
cta_note: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit. Also for Linux, and soon macOS.
hero_alt: The TaskForce app showing its dashboard, in a frosted glass window over an impressionist painting of mountains and water.
intro: You were one of the first people to use TaskForce, so you are among the first to hear it: TaskForce is now a desktop app. Same account, same interface, and your work stays with you.
demo_alt: Three views of TaskForce Desktop: a project board, an issue handed to Claude Code from the Assignee menu, and a Brain OS page with its links.
cap1: Projects, issues, cycles and a roadmap, on a board.
cap2: Claude Code takes an issue and works on your computer.
cap3: The Brain OS links your pages to each other and to your projects.
promise: It all stays with you. Your projects live on your computer, the app sends no usage data, and it works offline once you are signed in.
install_h2: Three steps, and you are in.
steps_alt: The three steps: download TaskForce-Setup-1.2.1.exe, install it without administrator rights, then sign in with your TaskForce account.
note_hesitate: If Windows hesitates, that is expected: the installer is not signed yet. The install guide explains each message, and the VirusTotal report shows the scan of the file.
note_help: Need a hand? Email me and I will walk you through it.
note_updates: After that, the app updates itself.
work_h2: Bring it along, or start fresh.
card1:
Sign in with the same account, then Operations, From the web app, Copy everything: your workspaces arrive with their Brain OS and projects.

It is a copy: the web app keeps everything until it closes (date to come, an email will tell you). To redo: teammates, connections and AI settings.
card2:
Create your free account from the app, go through the three-step setup, then create your first project.

Claude Code connects in one click in Settings, Agents, if it is installed and signed in to your account.
oss_p: All the code is public, under the AGPL-3.0 license. No need to code to help: a two-line email counts too.
oss1: The code, and how it is built.
oss2: It helps others find it, and you follow its releases.
oss3: Open an issue, or email me.
closing: The best way to judge it is to try it on a real project. Tell me what you think.
github_line: Or see it on GitHub.
ps: P.S. This email is also part of a series of tests 😁 If the app gives you trouble, or if you genuinely want to use it, share it or champion it, tell me: by email, by text for the happy few who have my number (it was never handed out lightly 😌), or by opening an issue on the project. Never in the field of project management has so much been owed by one developer to so few beta testers. Thank you 🚀
footer_tagline: TaskForce, the free and open source app to plan your work and hand tasks to AI agents.
footer_why: You are receiving this email because you have a TaskForce account.
